claim: Web Summit Lisbon runs from 9 to 12 November.
Henna Virkkunen, Executive Vice-President, joins a fireside chat on Centre Stage on Tuesday 10 November from 11:05 to 11:25, according to the Commission.
A DG Connect masterclass, 'Data spaces for SMEs: Turning shared data into value', runs from 12:00 to 12:45 on 10 November.
A 'First timers at Web Summit' meetup runs from 11:00 to 11:55 in Meetup 4, per Web Summit's listing.
The Commission's DG Connect is at Web Summit from 10 to 12 November.
The second UniVerse: Academia Empreendedora is hosted by the University of Lisbon on 10 November at the Portugal Pavilion Congress Centre.
Nine Portuguese higher education institutions take part in UniVerse.
The Commission lists DG GROW at stand E415 and HaDEA at stand E418, both in Pavilion 4, and EuroHPC at stand E405.
Técnico's stand is in Pavilion 2 (E272) and is open until 12 November.
Técnico brings six spin-offs to Web Summit: Acubic, Keel, Opsivision.ai, RTBEAMTECH, RipeNew and Testwaves.
